added_lines: UiPath Platform's valuable features include its end-to-end automation capabilities, intuitive drag-and-drop interface, and broad integration options across applications like SAP, Excel, and SharePoint. Advanced AI functions and OCR enhance document processing, while Orchestrator offers centralized control and scheduling. Both no-code and low-code environments promote ease of use for diverse user skillsets. The platform supports rapid deployment and scalability, providing extensive learning resources and community support. It reduces human error, frees time for strategic tasks, and enables seamless automation with significant cost savings.

Many users express difficulties with UiPath Platform's complex licensing structure and find pricing high, especially for small businesses. Debugging is often highlighted as clunky and less effective compared to competitors like Blue Prism. Users desire simpler integration with third-party applications, improved machine learning and AI capabilities, and a more intuitive user interface. The frequent updates and lack of backward compatibility sometimes disrupt workflows. Technical support has been noted as less responsive or helpful. Enhancements in community engagement and updated documentation are suggested. Users recommend seamless integration for cloud-based operations and better automation of processes involving legacy systems and Citrix environments.

Companies using UiPath Platform report significant ROI through time and cost savings. Automation reduces invoice processing time by 60-75% and boosts data accuracy by over 90%. Several departments, like finance and HR, benefit from automation. Firms save thousands of hours annually, leading to millions in cost avoidance. While initial costs exist, returns often appear within 6-12 months. Many have reduced human errors, seen increased capacity, and avoided hiring additional staff.

Enterprise users of UiPath Platform frequently highlight its higher cost compared to competitors such as Microsoft Power Automate and Automation Anywhere. The platform offers a variety of licensing options, including a free Community Edition, but the Enterprise Edition can be perceived as expensive, especially for small businesses. Licensing complexity adds challenges, with additional costs often incurred for features like Document Understanding and AI components. Despite the costs, enterprises appreciate the significant ROI, flexibility, and robust automation capabilities UiPath provides.

Organizations primarily utilize UiPath Platform for business process automation, focusing on streamlining repetitive and manual tasks. Users highlight its application in automating finance, HR, supply chain, and IT processes. They mention integrating AI functionalities for invoice processing, document understanding, and intelligent data capture. Teams utilize unattended bots for tasks like data extraction, reconciliation, and invoice processing, significantly reducing manual interventions. Many companies deploy UiPath Platform on both cloud and on-premises, depending on specific business needs.

UiPath Platform's customer service and support are responsive and knowledgeable, with rapid response times, often addressing issues within 24-48 hours. Users appreciate the technical team's willingness to help and the community support, which provides additional resources. Some users note occasional delays in complex cases, but overall, the support is considered reliable. The platform offers premium support packages, enhancing service quality for those who opt for it, ensuring efficient resolution and user satisfaction.

Most users find UiPath Platform's initial setup straightforward and easy, often taking from a few hours to a couple of days. The installation process is simplified with clear documentation and support, even for on-premises and cloud deployments. While some experience challenges with specific configurations or technical environments, many praise the setup for being logical and manageable, even for those without extensive technical expertise, and appreciate the smooth transition and integration.

UiPath Platform is highly scalable, adaptable across various organizations and needs. Users can seamlessly add bots and licenses, enhancing their automation capabilities. The platform's modular design supports diverse processes, allowing multiple robots to operate concurrently without infrastructure concerns. This flexibility allows for growth but depends on the organization's licenses and technical expertise. While stable for many, some highlight challenges with large-scale deployments. Nonetheless, UiPath continues to impress with its scalability features.

Users express mixed opinions on UiPath Platform's stability. Many praise its reliability, rating it between eight and ten, and appreciate its robust performance. Issues noted include occasional crashes, errors, and challenges with updates. Some find it less stable with complex tasks or integrations, while others see improvements with recent versions. Factors like infrastructure and external applications often affect perceived stability.

removed_lines: UiPath Platform is renowned for its intuitive, user-friendly interface that facilitates easy automation without extensive coding. Its low-code and drag-and-drop capabilities allow rapid automation creation, reducing manual tasks and human error. Key features include robust integration with AI, machine learning, and various third-party tools, enhancing data processing and automation efficiency. The Orchestrator offers centralized management, while UiPath Academy and strong community support excel in training and troubleshooting, making automation adaptable for diverse industries and complex processes.

Feedback for UiPath Platform highlights some areas for improvement, including complexities in the licensing model and costs, which can be prohibitive for smaller businesses. Users desire greater backward compatibility, especially during updates, as well as more robust debugging tools. Customization options for roles and interfaces could be more comprehensive, and there is a call for enhancing AI and machine learning capabilities. Better integration with legacy and third-party applications is sought, as well as smoother transitions between web and on-premises versions. Users want more efficient, intuitive user interfaces, particularly for new users. There is also a need for clearer and more straightforward documentation, supported by real-life use cases. Remote automation scenarios have significant room for enhancement, and users see value in expanding the platform to support broader accessibility across different environments and systems like Linux. More real-time transparency in monitoring and reporting capabilities is desired, with suggestions for more streamlined dashboards offering deeper insights. Industry-specific training and easier onboarding processes would also be advantageous. Improved technical support, better resource management, and streamlined development processes would help provide a more seamless user experience.

UiPath Platform users experienced substantial ROI, reporting significant time savings and reduced manual errors. Invoice processing automation achieved a 60-75% time reduction and over 90% data accuracy improvement. ROI varied by department and process complexity, with examples of financial and HR departments saving 80% of workforce resources. Some users reported cost savings of up to $5 million annually. Additionally, the time saved allowed employees to focus on higher-value tasks, driving overall business growth.

Enterprise users find UiPath Platform's pricing and licensing both expensive and complex, with direct comparisons often highlighting cost-effectiveness against Blue Prism but higher than Microsoft Power Automate. Licensing models are seen as rigid, requiring annual renewals and often incurring additional costs for premium features like intelligent automation. While cost concerns are notable, users acknowledge UiPath's comprehensive capabilities and positive ROI over time. Smaller businesses may find pricing challenging, but strategic scaling and cloud options offer potential cost savings. Despite flexibility claims, many users desire clearer pricing structures.

The primary use case for UiPath Platform is to automate repetitive business processes. Users employ it primarily for workflows in finance, HR, supply chain, and customer service, focusing on reducing manual tasks and enhancing efficiency. Specific applications include invoice processing, reconciliation, data extraction from documents, and email automation. They also leverage UiPath's AI capabilities for intelligent automation, combining RPA with AI-driven tasks to improve decision-making and process handling across various sectors.

UiPath Platform's customer service is noted for being responsive, knowledgeable, and supportive. Many users appreciate the rapid response times, though some face delays based on ticket priority and complexity. The strong user community provides valuable resources and timely assistance. Several users find the training and documentation beneficial. However, feedback indicates room for improvement in response consistency, support availability, and faster resolutions for complex issues. High satisfaction exists with premium support services.

Users found UiPath Platform's initial setup generally easy and intuitive. Many praised its cloud deployment for its simplicity, while on-premises installations presented varying degrees of complexity, often due to internal IT policies or unique organizational requirements. The setup usually required minimal personnel, though the time taken depended on project intricacies. Effective documentation and community support aided deployment, though some users faced challenges with specific configurations, particularly when integrating older systems or custom features.

UiPath Platform demonstrates excellent scalability, easily accommodating varied user needs across organizations. Its modular design supports the reuse of workflows, while licensing plays a crucial role in determining scalability limits. Users appreciate its ability to handle expanding automation demands, with user experiences highlighting seamless expansion and integration. Many users leverage its cloud capabilities for efficient scaling, while others address on-premises infrastructure and resource considerations. Scalability scores remain consistently high across diverse industries.

Many found UiPath's stability satisfactory, with some rating it 8 to 9 out of 10, citing robust performance and minimal issues. However, some encountered stability challenges, noting occasional crashes and bugs. Frequent updates sometimes led to temporary instability. Users highlighted the importance of proper setup and maintenance. Some rated stability as low as 3 due to interaction complexities with other systems. UiPath's cloud deployment was often praised for reliability.

My main use case for UiPath Platform includes multiple use cases. My experience is mostly on mainframes, Excel, web automation, agentic automation using Maestro, and some parts of SAP, ServiceNow, and API integrations as well.

One specific example of a use case I worked on with UiPath Platform is agentic automation, which we have gone live with recently. As Volvo is a logistic company mainly involved in manufacturing trucks and buses, we usually receive multiple orders to deliver to different vendors. After delivering the parts, sometimes we deliver defective parts or some parts get missed, causing vendors to raise discrepancies via email by attaching photos or describing in the mail body any parts that are missing. We get these discrepancies in our ERP system with all the details, and we extract everything to pass it to our agent, who analyzes the correctness of the discrepancy. If it is correct, it is approved; if not, it is rejected. If the agent cannot identify anything, it passes to human validation where a human will provide approval or rejection, affecting how the discrepancy is handled in the ERP.

The best feature I have observed in UiPath Platform is Data Services, as it significantly improved our handling of data compared to the previous Excel-based process. Monitoring Excel was often a hectic resolution, requiring use of SharePoint to facilitate access for multiple people, which led to file corruption issues. With the Data Fabric feature, we can manage and sort data effectively and fix everything smoothly.
